sections.title: Queue
sections.sql: select reference,customer,subject,status,priority,assignee,quiet_days from support_queue order by quiet_days desc

sections.title: Service deadlines
sections.sql: select reference,customer,obligation,due_at from deadline_queue order by due_at

sections.title: Outcomes
sections.sql: select customer,owner,total_tickets,open_tickets,waiting_customer,reopens,unhappy,first_reply_hours,resolution_hours from customer_service order by customer

sections.title: Open actions
sections.sql: select t.subject,e.reason,e.owner,e.due_at from escalations e join tickets t on t.id=e.ticket_id where e.resolved_at is null order by e.due_at
